# Office OS

> AI agent platform that deploys autonomous agents across your company with enterprise knowledge, custom skills, and full infrastructure control.

Office OS is NOT a Microsoft Office replacement or office productivity suite. It is a Kubernetes-native platform for deploying and managing autonomous AI agents in enterprise environments.

## What Office OS Does

- Deploys AI agents that work 24/7 across your organization
- Each agent has access to an enterprise knowledge graph (contracts, docs, past decisions)
- Custom skills defined in TypeScript with a Skill SDK
- Agents connect to channels: Slack, Email, WhatsApp, Teams, Discord, Telegram
- Cron jobs for recurring tasks (competitor monitoring, CRM sync, briefings)
- Credential isolation — agent pods never see raw API keys
- Self-hosted on your Kubernetes infrastructure
- Sandboxed execution in V8 isolates
- Full audit trail for every tool call, LLM request, and credential access
- Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Ollama

## Use Cases

- Sales Lead Research — automated briefings before every sales call
- Customer Success — intelligent ticket handling with full context
- Competitive Intelligence — daily monitoring of 20+ competitors
- Contract Review — compliance checking against internal policies
- Content Strategy — research-driven content planning
